project_type: FileForgeWorkbench (ffwb) -- a Rust Cargo workspace (~69 crates) building an egui/eframe desktop mainframe workstation (ISPF/File-AID inspired). This task touches the mainframe dataset stack crates: ff-idcams (IDCAMS command interpreter), ff-dscatalog (single catalog authority), ff-dsalloc, ff-governance-tests, ff-vfs, and ff-desktop (shell).
language: Rust (edition from workspace; max line length 100; ASCII-only .rs source).
build_system: Cargo workspace. Root Cargo.toml holds [workspace].members. cargo-nextest is used by the full gate. QUIRK: adding ff-dscatalog as a dep to ff-idcams must NOT create a dependency cycle -- Cargo rejects cycles at resolve time, so a clean scoped cargo check is itself the acyclicity proof.
test_framework: Rust built-in #[cfg(test)] + proptest + pretty_assertions + tempfile. Governance DAG rules live in ff-governance-tests (src/compliance.rs PROHIBITED_DEPENDENCIES, tests/architecture_compliance.rs, tests/mock_compilation.rs). TDD is MANDATORY: write the failing test first (red), then implement (green).
test_command: Scoped only: cargo test -p <crate>  (NEVER --workspace; NEVER cargo gate -- that is the owner's manual hand-off step).
verification_instructions: Per part: cargo fmt; cargo check -p <crate> --all-targets; cargo test -p <crate>; cargo clippy -p <crate> -- -D warnings. Run ALL shell commands via the pwsh7 non-interactive wrapper: C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "<cmd>". One command per invocation (no ;-chaining -- a guard hook blocks it). Prefer dedicated read/grep tools over Get-Content/Select-String. After scoped checks are clean, STOP and hand off to the owner for the full cargo gate --build (fallback: pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\ffwb-gate.ps1).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Cargo.lock regenerates on the next scoped cargo check after the dep add and the member-line removal. No other generated artefacts.
environment_constraints: Windows host. Use C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe (pwsh 7) non-interactively for every shell command. Do NOT touch .worktrees/. Do NOT run --workspace builds/tests or cargo gate (owner's manual step). Edits go DIRECTLY on branch main, uncommitted -- NO worktree, NO branch, NO commit, NO push.
contribution_requirements: ASCII-only .rs (no box-drawing, no em dash -- fix existing violations in ff-idcams/src/services.rs + lib.rs while editing them). 400-non-test-line rule per .rs file (split tests to a sibling _tests.rs; split big handlers by command group as a refactor). Every test carries // Validates: Requirement 28.x. Build ON the framework (framework-conformance.md): one command-dispatch seam, one focus latch, DatasetAccess is the single record-aware contract; a change to ff-vfs::BackendEnvironment is a FRAMEWORK CHANGE needing express owner confirmation. Update docs/quality/TCR.md and the relevant tasks.md on completion.
key_patterns: PRECEDENT 1 (crate retirement) = .agents/tasks/rcb7-vsam-wiring/feat003-finish-note.md -- the EXACT ff-vsam-services governance-edit pattern to mirror for ff-dataset-catalog. PRECEDENT 2 (trait repoint onto ff-dscatalog) = crates/ff-dsalloc/src/catalog_bridge.rs + allocation.rs -- depends on ff-dscatalog, keeps a thin local DTO (DatasetAllocationRequest) at the boundary and wraps DatasetAccess/CatalogService behind a small mockable bridge, holding opaque ff_dscatalog::DatasetHandle. The reconciled ff-dscatalog traits use &str DSNs + DatasetAttributes/DatasetFilter/VsamParams/VsamHandle and do NOT model define_path/verify_integrity/export/import/delete_gdg_base -- keep those IDCAMS-local, map the rest onto the trait.

stop_and_report: PART 2 (record-aware MAINFRAME SAVE) is a STOP-and-report finding: it is NOT achievable by wiring a BackendEnvironment sibling at the existing seam without a FRAMEWORK CHANGE (ff-vfs::BackendEnvironment::save is a byte-write (path,bytes) contract; the EnvironmentRegistry is a closed enum with one host_fs backend; open_mainframe_dsn binds HOSTFS with no owning_env; the mainframe VFS provider is unregistered; the spec houses the mainframe CE in ff-idcams and defers it). FEAT-002 records the finding + prerequisites and defers the build; it changes NO .rs behaviour and leaves native SAVE byte-identical. See plan.md Part 2 for the five evidence points.
